topic: SIP basics: what a SIP is and why monthly habits matter
judge_note: Salary day is a real, relatable moment, and the Tanglish question feels like a friend asking, not a brochure.

slides.headline: Salary vandhachu. SIP date fix panniteengala?
slides.subhead: Maadha maadham same date, same amount. Chinna habit, periya relief.

points.title: Same day, every month
points.text: Pick an amount and a date, like the 10th or 15th. It goes out automatically.

points.title: Small amounts add up
points.text: ₹5,000 monthly for ten years means ₹6 lakh invested. Illustration, not a return.

points.title: Paati did this too
points.text: Chits, RDs, gold coins: Paati saved steadily. SIP is one more way to continue.

slides.headline: Send this to your 'next month' friend.
slides.cta: Save and share when salary lands.
slides.footnote: Size matters less than start date. Mutual funds are subject to market risks.

caption:
Paati chit date maariye, unga SIP date-um fix pannunga.

Small amount, same day, no guessing. Mutual funds are subject to market risks.

What did your Amma or Appa save every month?

#Chennai #NammaChennai #SIP #MoneyHabits #TamilNadu #ChennaiFamilies #MutualFunds
translation_en: Salary came in. Have you fixed your SIP date? / Every month the same date, the same amount. Small habit, big relief. / Like Paati's chit date, fix your SIP date too.
